remarks: Thoughtfully reimagined in 2024-2025, this four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath Chatsworth residence pairs refined contemporary finishes with a warm, inviting sense of home. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, the residence spans approximately 2,370 square feet on an 8,854-square-foot lot, with beautifully updated interiors and thoughtful details throughout. Inside, soaring two-story ceilings create an immediate sense of volume, while an open, light-filled layout connects the main living spaces. The renovated kitchen is finished with Calacatta quartz countertops, ceiling-height cabinetry, GE stainless steel appliances, and a charming breakfast nook with custom banquette seating.
